source: GTABase + GTA Fandom Wiki + community benchmarks
note: All GTA Online income sources. Figures = net GTA$/hr solo, 2024/25 patch level.

sources.name: Cluckin' Bell Farm Raid
tips: 4-mission contract, ~$500K payout per run
Fully solo capable
No setup cost — pure profit from first run
Cooldown applies between contract runs
sources.notes: One of the best money-makers added in 2024. No setup, no property required — just start it from the phone.

sources.name: KnoWay Out
tips: Anti-surveillance theme, anti-KnoWay autonomous vehicle network
Clean solo mission series
Competitive with mid-tier businesses for pure $/hr
sources.notes: Money Fronts DLC 2025. Strong $/hr, no property barrier to entry.

sources.name: Mr. Faber Work
tips: Money laundering recovery missions
Good variety across mission types
Released alongside Agents of Sabotage content update
sources.notes: Agents of Sabotage DLC. Solid mid-tier contract work.

sources.name: Oscar Guzman Flies Again
tips: 6 missions, Trevor Philips storyline continuation
Pairs well with Bounty Targets business
Good story missions for the era
sources.notes: Bottom Dollar Bounties DLC companion missions.

sources.name: Project Overthrow
tips: 6 counter-ops vs Merryweather
Good challenge, mid-tier payout
No property requirement
sources.notes: San Andreas Mercenaries DLC. Solid mid-tier contract.

sources.name: Short Trips (Franklin & Lamar)
tips: Franklin Clinton guest missions from The Contract DLC
Fast, story-driven missions with good payout
Unlocked by completing The Contract VIP work
sources.notes: The Contract DLC. Fast, story-light missions with excellent $/hr for their length.

sources.name: Operation Paper Trail
tips: 5 IAA missions with Agent ULP
Fast completion = good $/hr
Criminal Enterprises update
First-time bonus adds significant value
sources.notes: Criminal Enterprises DLC. IAA counter-intelligence missions.

sources.name: The First Dose
tips: 5 story missions that unlock the Acid Lab (one-time run)
One-time story run — primarily a gateway to $480k/hr Acid Lab income
Play on easy difficulty for speed
sources.notes: Primarily done once to unlock Acid Lab. Very strong value as a setup investment.

sources.name: The Last Dose
tips: Completes the Drug Wars storyline
Unlocks full Acid Lab production upgrades
Also done primarily once for Acid Lab optimisation
sources.notes: Sequel to First Dose. Rewards Acid Lab production and equipment upgrades.

sources.name: A Superyacht Life
tips: $100k per mission regardless of completion time
Requires a Yacht — one of GTA Online's most expensive vanity purchases
Not worth buying yacht for income alone
sources.notes: 6 missions. The Yacht pays for itself slowly — buy only if you want the lifestyle.

sources.name: Stunt Races
tips: Payout scales with placement and time
Triple + double money events greatly boost $/hr
Fun but not efficient for grinding
sources.notes: Competitive racing format. Best during 2× or 3× event weeks.

sources.name: Time Trials (Weekly)
tips: One-off $100k payout per week (resets Thursday)
RC Bandito Time Trial also pays ~$100k per week
Takes under 5 min with the right vehicle
Always complete weekly — free money
sources.notes: Weekly rotating time trial + RC Bandito challenge. Together = $200k+ free per week in ~10 minutes.

sources.name: Daily Objectives
tips: 3 objectives per day (Basic, Routine, Advanced tiers)
7-day streak bonus: $500k
28-day streak bonus: $1M
Always complete — pure free money alongside other grind
sources.notes: Background income. Don't grind these alone but always complete them. Weekly/monthly streak bonuses are significant.

sources.name: The Doomsday Heist — Act I
tips: Best completed as part of the full 3-act sequence
First-time completion bonus: $50k extra per act
Hard difficulty adds 25% to payout
sources.notes: Act I of The Doomsday Heist. Required for first-time $1M bonus. 3-4 players needed.

sources.name: The Doomsday Heist — Act II
tips: Hardest of the 3 acts but highest solo $/hr
The Deluxo setup is critical — protect it
Hard difficulty + 25% bonus makes this worthwhile
sources.notes: Act II is the hardest Doomsday act. Payout is strong for the effort.

sources.name: Gerald's Last Play
tips: Gerald's Criminal Enterprises update missions
Better payout than original Gerald missions
Good filler between business resupply cycles
sources.notes: Gerald's updated mission strand from Criminal Enterprises. Noticeably better than older contact missions.
